extraction.document_summary: AIA Guaranteed Protect Plus (IV) is a long-term life insurance plan that provides death and total & permanent disability (TPD) protection, with a “multiplier” feature to boost coverage up to 5 times. You can choose a multiplier cut-off age of 65 or 75; after that cut-off, the coverage amount is reduced back to the basic coverage amount (e.g., 5X coverage ends and returns to S$100,000 in the example). Protection also includes accumulated cash value with potential (non-guaranteed) bonuses. Premiums can be paid for a limited term of 15, 20 or 25 years, after which benefits continue. The plan also offers options during events: defer premiums for 12 consecutive months upon involuntary retrenchment, and an Income Drawdown Facility that lets you take 50% or 100% of coverage as cash value into annual payouts for 10 years. AIA Vitality integration may add “PowerUp Dollar” free additional coverage (up to 37.5%).
quality_notes: Brochure contains sufficient structural information on base benefits (death, TPD), multiplier mechanics, premium term choices, cash value/bonuses, and event-based options (premium deferral, income drawdown).

Some mechanics refer to other product summaries (e.g., critical illness lists and exclusions) without reproducing full details here, so critical illness benefit conditions cannot be fully extracted as covered_conditions.
No explicit free-look period, grace period, or exact guaranteed cash value schedule is stated; only general statements about cash value and non-guaranteed bonuses appear.

The plan includes premium discount and PowerUp Dollar rules tied to AIA Vitality; amounts are described in terms of percentages/caps but not as a standalone payable benefit amount within the base product section.

policies.quick_summary: Long-term life insurance with death and TPD protection, boosted via a coverage multiplier (up to 5X) with a cut-off age of 65 or 75, plus accumulated cash value and potential bonuses. Offers limited-payment premiums (15/20/25 years) and event-based options such as premium deferral for 12 months (upon involuntary retrenchment) and an Income Drawdown Facility (50% or 100% of coverage into 10 annual cash payouts). Coverage reduces after the multiplier cut-off age and death/TPD cease at specified ages (death to 100, TPD to 70). Eligibility integration with AIA Vitality may provide additional free coverage via PowerUp Dollar (up to 150% of base PowerUp Dollar).
policies.coverage_term_description: Death coverage and TPD coverage have specific cessation ages; death coverage ceases at age 100 and TPD ceases at age 70.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Premiums can be paid over 15, 20 or 25 years; after completion of premium payments, you continue to enjoy benefits.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Potential bonuses are mentioned; bonuses are non-guaranteed and depend on experience of AIA’s participating fund, and annual bonuses form part of guaranteed benefits once declared and credited.
policy_termination_events: On reaching multiplier cut-off age of 65 or 75, the coverage amount is reduced to the basic coverage amount (multiplier ends).
important_caveats: Premium deferment option refers to Premium Pass Option and can only be exercised once after the 3rd policy year in the event of Involuntary Retrenchment, provided the policy is in force and premiums have been fully paid for the first three years.
Income Drawdown Facility can only be utilised once after the multiplier cut-off age of 65/75 or end of premium term (whichever is later) before age 85.
Flexibility to purchase another whole life or endowment policy with no further medical questions asked is stated to be option-based and can only be exercised once and will cease at age 55.
Critical illness expansion and the lists/exclusions for critical illnesses/special conditions are referenced to other product summaries.

review_notes: Classification set to whole_life based on long-lasting protection and death/TPD cessation ages stated; the brochure does not explicitly label the base product as whole life or endowment.
Multiplier options (2X/3X/5X) are captured as plan tiers using the brochure’s assumed S$100,000 illustration; exact available multiplier selections are not enumerated beyond 'up to 5 times'.

Critical illness and waiver elements are treated as riders because the brochure explicitly refers to adding the 'Early Critical Protector Life (IV) rider' in the example, and it separately names Critical Protector/Early Critical Protector products.
PowerUp Dollar and premium discount rules are extracted as features/coverage extension; no standalone premium amounts or guaranteed additional coverage amounts are stated beyond caps/percentages.
